```python
def test_remove_vowels():
    # basic
    assert remove_vowels("hello world") == "hll wrld"
    # all five vowels, lowercase
    assert remove_vowels("aeiou") == ""
    # uppercase vowels removed too
    assert remove_vowels("AEIOU") == ""
    # mixed case preserved on consonants
    assert remove_vowels("StackOverflow") == "Stckvrflw"
    # no vowels -> unchanged
    assert remove_vowels("rhythm") == "rhythm"
    # empty string
    assert remove_vowels("") == ""
    # only non-vowel chars (digits, spaces, punctuation)
    assert remove_vowels("123 !?") == "123 !?"
    # y is NOT a vowel here
    assert remove_vowels("my gym") == "my gym"
    # vowels interleaved with spaces
    assert remove_vowels("a e i o u") == "    "
    # unicode vowels (not in the list) pass through
    assert remove_vowels("cafÃ©") == "cfÃ©"
```
